programs.description: Ashok becomes distraught following the demise of his wife. In a bid to usurp his wealth, Dilip, Ashok's cousin, takes advantage of the situation and begins to torture him.
Satinath, a ranger, empowers forest tribals to fight their oppressors' exploitation, securing their rights and protecting the environment.
Swayamsiddha is in for a rude shock when she gets to know that her husband has intellectual disabilities. When she learns that her brother-in-law is responsible for this, she decides to confront him.
A college student becomes the victim of cyber crime when his flamboyant nature becomes his own worst enemy, leaving a devastating aftermath.

After a child princess is gifted a harmonium, she soon gets orphaned, then widowed and lastly left penniless. After the harmonium is sold, it brings bad luck to whomsoever owns it.

Abhagini is tortured by her stepmother all her life, but she decides to make a new start after leaving the city. Initially, the new family she is living with dislikes her, but she soon wins them over.
The lives of two lovers, Seema and Jeeban, change when Seema's father gets her married to someone else. However, when Seema's husband commits suicide, she goes to the village where she met Jeeban.
Gopal Bhar is appointed as a jester in Raja Krishnachandra's court in medieval Bengal. His wit and humour are well-known in the region and his exploits always have a significant social message.
A pair independently examines various justifications regarding a suicide case following their reading of a press bulletin. These partners separately investigate the factors for this demise.
George is in a dilemma when he is hired by Rishin to murder someone. However, he soon realises that his client suffers from schizophrenia and wants to kill himself.

An avid traveller from a wealthy family marries a woman during one of his travails. However, tragedy strikes after he embarks on another sojourn after marriage, unaware that his wife is pregnant.
A maidservant witnesses the horrific tortures subjected to her employer's daughter by her in-laws. Eventually, she hatches a plot to infiltrate the house and rescue her mistress.
